description: 이슈 #46 NLI cross-encoder 검증용 합성 케이스 — contradiction / neutral / entailment 판정 비교

cases.label: contradiction
cases.description: SOP: 전원 차단 후 점검 / 조치계획: 가동 중 점검 — 명확한 모순
cases.sop_chunk: Before any inspection or maintenance, shut down the machine completely and lock out the power supply. Never inspect or adjust components while the machine is running.
cases.action_step: Inspect the spindle bearing and adjust tension while the machine is running at reduced speed.
cases.note: 코사인 유사도는 'inspect', 'machine', 'running' 공유로 높은 점수 → APPROVE 오판. NLI는 contradiction 감지 → REJECT

cases.label: contradiction
cases.description: SOP: 냉각 후 작업 / 조치계획: 즉시 작업
cases.sop_chunk: Allow the tool to cool down for at least 30 minutes before replacement. Hot tools can cause burns and measurement errors.
cases.action_step: Replace the worn tool immediately without waiting for the tool to cool down to speed up production.
cases.note: SOP는 30분 냉각을 명시하나 조치계획은 즉시 교체를 지시 — contradiction

cases.label: entailment
cases.description: SOP: 공구 교체 절차 / 조치계획: SOP 절차 준수
cases.sop_chunk: Stop the machine after the current cycle completes. Remove the worn tool from the spindle and replace with a new tool of the same specification.
cases.action_step: Stop the CNC machine after the current cycle and replace the worn tool with a new tool of the same specification.
cases.note: 조치계획이 SOP를 충실히 따름 — 두 방식 모두 APPROVE

cases.label: neutral
cases.description: SOP: 공구 교체 절차 / 조치계획: 관련 없는 센서 보정
cases.sop_chunk: Stop the machine after the current cycle completes. Remove the worn tool from the spindle and replace with a new tool of the same specification.
cases.action_step: Calibrate the temperature sensor to ensure accurate readings for predictive maintenance.
cases.note: 주제가 다르지만 모순도 아님 — neutral은 REVIEW로 라우팅

cases.label: contradiction
cases.description: SOP: 안전장비 착용 필수 / 조치계획: 안전장비 생략
cases.sop_chunk: Always wear appropriate PPE including safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, and steel-toed boots before performing any maintenance on the CNC machine.
cases.action_step: Perform the tool replacement quickly without PPE to minimize downtime.
cases.note: 안전 절차 위반 — SOP는 PPE 필수, 조치계획은 생략. 코사인은 'tool', 'replacement', 'maintenance' 공유로 높은 점수
